caveats: Repeated takedowns may still degrade trust, impose costs and generate intelligence.
Leatherman did not claim that one seizure would permanently eliminate all successor communities.
inferences: Repeated resurgence shows that domain seizures often displace rather than permanently eliminate cybercrime communities.

data.claim: Leatherman publicly characterized a BreachForums seizure as removing a key cybercrime hub, but BreachForums and successor communities repeatedly returned after prior FBI-led seizures and displaced activity to other channels.

sources.title: BreachForums returns just weeks after FBI-led takedown
Third time lucky? The FBI just took down BreachForums, again

summary: Leatherman publicly promoted a later BreachForums domain seizure, while the forum and successors had repeatedly reappeared after earlier seizures.
title: BreachForums repeatedly returned after FBI-led seizures
